summary: Tested IELTS Mock Exam SaaS (backend + frontend). 14/14 backend pytest tests passed. Frontend landing, dashboard, exam preparation, and in-progress listening module all rendered correctly with expected functionality (timer counting down, all 10 questions visible immediately, section/question navigators, pre-loaded audio play button).

issues: PRD specifies 'PlayStation-inspired LIGHT MODE design' but landing hero and exam page header use BLACK/dark backgrounds with white text. The middle sections of landing and the question panels are light. Result is a mixed dark-light theme rather than the requested pure light mode. Decide on consistent treatment (e.g., light hero with PlayStation-blue accents).

action_items: Optional: align entire UI to LIGHT MODE per PRD; currently landing hero & exam header are dark.

Reading, Writing, Speaking module flows were not deeply walked through end-to-end (only the listening preparation + in-progress UI was navigated). Main agent or next iteration can self-test by switching `?module=reading|writing|speaking` on the exam URL with the test session cookie.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1000+ lines and includes seed data, auth, scoring, and AI generation in a single file (>700 line guideline). Consider splitting into modules: auth.py, exams.py, audio.py, scoring.py, seed.py.
/api/exams/{exam_id}/full leaks correct answers without auth – should require auth (admin) or be removed.
score_objective() iterates exam[module]['sections' or 'passages']; works due to ternary but readability is poor. Refactor for clarity.
Audio is base64-encoded in MongoDB which inflates document size by ~33%; consider GridFS or object storage for scale.
OpenRouter call uses json.loads on raw model output without try/except; malformed JSON will 500 the request – wrap with error handling.
Cookie set with samesite='none' + secure=True is correct for cross-site, but no CSRF protection. Acceptable for OAuth-only flow but worth noting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of attempted flows (landing, auth-protected dashboard via cookie, exam preparation, listening in-progress UI)
